title: b7z9.25.6: Python+Rust: implement overlap window arithmetic for multi-root
description: Spec R-02a-040: overlap = beacons within (setup_window + occupied_time + guard_window). MultiRootState window is caller-scoped in both Python (slot_coordination.py:303-357) and Rust (multi_instance.rs:1033-1103). Implement the window arithmetic internally so add_candidate() can validate beacon timing. Values come from beacon fields (setup_window, occupied_time, guard).
